verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships first-party credential-issuing capability relevant to agents. Its API Key plugin creates, manages and verifies keys with rate limiting, custom expiration, and remaining-count/refill limits. The MCP plugin lets an app act as an OAuth authorization server for agent clients, and the homepage claims 'Auth for AI agents… token exchange, and agent delegation.' However, the evidence never shows per-key permission or scope restrictions, so least-privilege scoping itself is only implied by usage limits and the OAuth/delegation claims. Missing for 10: documented per-credential permission/scope assignment for API keys or delegated agent tokens, detail on how agent delegation constrains privileges, independent or hands-on corroboration.
